programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Road Trip Rescue
programs.desc: Carrying three baby kangaroos and an emu, the Irwins caravan into the Australian Outback to release the animals on Mourachan, their giant wildlife conservation property  plans shift when they discover more animals in need of rescue along the way.

programs.title: I Was Prey: Night Stalker
programs.desc: A black bear charges Joe Azzouggagh and his German shepherd, Ace, deep in the Ontario wilderness  single father Andrew Dickehage, forced to walk six miles along a rural road at night, comes under attack from unseen predators.

programs.title: Carter's W.A.R.: Sold Into Slavery
programs.desc: Ivan is investigating the illegal trade of bush meat in Kinshasa when he stumbles upon three captive baby chimpanzees that are being sold on the black market.
